anti_overfit_boundary: No prediction-time use of world identity.
No weight-grid expansion after design outcomes are observed.
No evaluation-seed access unless a design winner freezes.
No real or historical race inputs, RESULT/PAYOUT, odds, economics, ROI, bankroll, or holdout data.
Synthetic PASS cannot promote a real model or establish real calibration, edge, ROI, or profitability.

architecture.mixture_rule: P_mix=(1-w)*P_C0+w*P_N1 for every ordered-top3 outcome; one global w shared by every race and world.

eligibility: candidate max world mean KL must be strictly lower than C0 max world mean KL
candidate mean KL in every world must be <= 1.05 times C0 mean KL in that world
design_selection.eligible_count_positive: Freeze exactly one winner by the fixed selection order before evaluation scoring.
design_selection.eligible_count_zero: NO_DEVELOPMENT_ELIGIBLE_GLOBAL_MIXTURE; do not score evaluation seed.

evaluation_batch.access_rule: Only score if exactly one design winner freezes.

all_required: frozen mixture max world mean KL strictly lower than C0 max world mean KL
frozen mixture mean-of-world mean KL <= C0 mean-of-world mean KL
frozen mixture KL in every world <= 1.05 times C0 KL in that world

objective: Test whether one globally frozen convex mixture of the already-preregistered C0_SCORE_PL and N1_CONDITIONAL ordered-top3 probability objects can hedge synthetic architecture misspecification across W0-W4 without observing world identity at prediction time or retuning by world. Select at most one weight on a synthetic design seed, then evaluate it once on a disjoint synthetic seed.

predecessor.finding: N1 lowest KL only in W2; C0 lowest in W0/W1/W3/W4; no stable architecture advantage.
